llm_rationale: The column is a model-standardized aggregate biomass of a trawl event's catch, while the only candidate is the body mass of an individual fish, so nothing on the shortlist is the variable and a search on the full description found no catch-biomass term.
llm_missing_context: the standardization model and the reference basis (such as standard effort) the biomass is adjusted to
llm_bundle_summary: model-standardized aggregate catch biomass in kilograms for a trawl event
llm_new_term_definition: The aggregate biomass of the catch from one trawl event, adjusted by a statistical standardization model so that values are comparable across events.
